ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 22 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest consensus signal of the batch. Q2 FY27 earnings print after market close tomorrow (Aug 26) with consensus expecting $2.09 EPS on ~$93.6B revenue, estimates revised up 6.67% over the past 3 months. A ~$304 average analyst price target vs. ~$214–$225 current price represents a ~40–42% gap, and the $1T order book plus Vera Rubin processor ramp could drive an upside guide. All 22 runs flagged a defined-risk options structure (bull call spread or straddle) as strongly preferred over outright stock, given NVDA's documented post-earnings sell-the-news pattern over the last 4 quarters.
ideas.catalyst: Q2 FY27 earnings report: Wednesday August 26, 2026 after market close (5PM EDT)
ideas.edge: Consensus analyst target ~$304 vs. ~$214 current price = ~42% gap; revenue estimate revised up 6.67% in past 3 months to $93.6B; stock up only +21% YTD vs. SOX +63%, creating relative catch-up potential on a beat
ideas.bull_case: A revenue beat above $93.6B with strong Vera Rubin ramp guidance and $1T backlog commentary could trigger a re-rating toward the $304–$350 analyst target range; the SOX underperformance gap snaps back sharply.
ideas.bear_case: NVDA has sold off after each of the last 4 earnings beats — a 'sell-the-news' reaction even on strong results is a well-established pattern, and any guidance miss or export restriction headline could accelerate the fade.

ideas.name: SK Hynix Inc. (ADR)
ideas.thesis: SKHY appeared in all 22 overnight screens (20 high, 2 medium conviction), making it the joint-top consensus idea alongside NVDA. The stock pulled back ~12–13% from $178 highs to the mid-$150s despite a KRW 40 trillion (~$29B) buyback announced August 19 and a locked-in $500B+ NVIDIA–SK Group AI infrastructure partnership. HBM capacity is reported fully allocated through 2027. With a beta of 2.4, SKHY is the highest-leverage listed proxy for a NVDA earnings beat, and the buyback provides a structural floor at current levels. Analyst consensus target of ~$245 vs. ~$155–$163 current price implies ~50% upside.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA earnings Aug 26 as direct HBM demand read-through; KRW 40T (~$29B) buyback running Aug 20–Nov 2026 providing ongoing price floor
ideas.edge: Analyst consensus target ~$245 vs. ~$155–$163 current price = ~50% gap; beta 2.4 amplifies NVDA move; 73.54% ROIC with low leverage (debt/capital 0.12); HBM supply fully allocated through 2027
ideas.bull_case: A NVDA beat validating AI memory demand accelerates the $178→$155 pullback reversal; buyback provides active floor and the $500B+ partnership de-risks long-term HBM revenue visibility, justifying a re-rate toward analyst targets.
ideas.bear_case: High beta cuts both ways — a NVDA miss or sell-the-news reaction would amplify losses on SKHY; ADR liquidity and FX (KRW/USD) add additional risk layers not present in the underlying.

ideas.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (Nasdaq-100 ETF)
ideas.thesis: QQQ appeared in 19 of 22 screens as the preferred vehicle for capturing a compounded volatility event: NVDA earnings Wednesday August 26 AH followed by Fed Chair Warsh's first-ever Jackson Hole keynote Friday August 28. The ETF's heavy NVDA and Mag7 concentration makes it a direct amplifier of both catalysts. With VIX at 15.05, near-term options remain relatively cheap ahead of what screens consistently identified as a back-to-back binary event window. All runs flagged a straddle or strangle as preferable to outright ETF ownership — the structure captures a large move in either direction with defined max loss.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA earnings Aug 26 AH (primary Nasdaq catalyst) + Fed Chair Warsh's inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Friday Aug 28 ~10AM ET; September FOMC Sep 15–16 as secondary overhang
ideas.edge: VIX at 15.05 keeps near-term options historically cheap ahead of two sequential market-moving events; Sep hike odds dropped from ~54% to ~39% on weak NFP and cooling inflation — a dovish or neutral Warsh removes the primary Nasdaq overhang
ideas.bull_case: NVDA beats and raises guidance Wednesday, and Warsh delivers a neutral or dovish-leaning Jackson Hole address Friday — both overhangs clear in 72 hours and QQQ stages a multi-percent relief rally.
ideas.bear_case: Warsh uses his inaugural speech to signal a hawkish stance (3 FOMC members already dissented for hikes in July), shocking a market still pricing only ~39% September hike probability and driving a sharp QQQ selloff even if NVDA results are strong.

ideas.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
ideas.thesis: SPY appeared in 7 of 22 screens primarily as a macro hedge vehicle into the Warsh Jackson Hole speech Friday August 28. With September FOMC hike/hold odds near a 39–55% coin-flip and an unusual 9-3 dissent vote on record, the market consensus appears to assume a 'neutral' Warsh tone — making a hawkish lean an unpriced shock. The 2022 Jackson Hole precedent (S&P dropped 3%+ on a single speech) was cited across multiple runs. VIX at 15.05 makes protective puts or a put spread a low-cost, defined-risk hedge. Screens noted a SPY put spread is preferable to outright shorting the ETF.
ideas.catalyst: Fed Chair Warsh's first-ever Jackson Hole keynote: Friday August 28, 2026 ~10AM ET; July PCE data releases same morning Aug 26; September FOMC Sep 15–16
ideas.edge: Market consensus prices a 'neutral' Warsh tone — hawkish surprise is unpriced; 2022 precedent: S&P dropped 3%+ on a single Jackson Hole speech; VIX 15.05 makes put spread hedge historically cheap relative to tail risk
ideas.bull_case: Warsh delivers neutral or ambiguously dovish remarks, September hike expectations fall further, and the macro overhang clears — SPY re-rates higher as the summer rally resumes with NVDA earnings as an additional tailwind.
ideas.bear_case: A hawkish Warsh surprise (rate-hike signal or 'higher for longer' framing) hits an equity market at S&P 7,652 with a 10-yr yield already at 4.658% — mirrors 2022 and could trigger a sharp multi-percent drawdown into FOMC.

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.thesis: MSFT appeared in 5 of 22 screens as the preferred lower-beta, lower-binary-risk way to play the NVDA earnings read-through and ongoing AI capex supercycle. Hyperscalers are projected to spend $600B+ collectively in 2026 AI infrastructure capex, and Azure is a direct beneficiary of confirmed NVDA order momentum. The stock trades at its cheapest forward multiple since 2023 (21–22x NTM earnings) with a ~22% gap to the 97-analyst consensus target of ~$590 vs. ~$483 current price — and carries no near-term earnings overhang unlike NVDA.
ideas.catalyst: NVDA earnings Aug 26 as hyperscaler capex confirmation read-through; Jackson Hole Warsh speech Aug 28 as macro clearing event; $600B+ 2026 AI infrastructure capex cycle ongoing
ideas.edge: 97-analyst consensus target ~$590 vs. current ~$483 = ~22% gap; trading at 21–22x NTM earnings, cheapest forward multiple since 2023; showed relative strength Aug 24 (+0.84% vs. Nasdaq -0.76%)
ideas.bull_case: NVDA beats and guides strong, confirming hyperscaler AI capex demand — Azure directly benefits and MSFT's lower-beta profile means it captures upside without NVDA's post-earnings vol risk; dovish Warsh further re-rates growth tech.
ideas.bear_case: A NVDA miss or hawkish Warsh shock hits all large-cap tech indiscriminately; MSFT's $487 price already reflects much of the AI capex narrative, limiting outperformance on a positive outcome relative to higher-beta peers.

ideas.name: Apple Inc.
ideas.thesis: AAPL appeared in 5 of 22 screens, all at medium conviction, flagging a muted market reaction to today's AI-developer Mac Mini and Mac Studio launch (Aug 25) as a potential entry point. The stock dipped ~0.16–0.46% on launch day despite entering a new AI developer hardware revenue vector not yet reflected in near-term estimates. At ~$310 with next earnings expected late October 2026, AAPL offers a lower-beta way to ride AI hardware theme momentum if NVDA's results validate the AI capex cycle — with a product refresh as a standalone near-term catalyst.
ideas.catalyst: AI-developer Mac Mini and Mac Studio launched Aug 25, 2026 (today, largely unpriced); NVDA earnings Aug 26 as macro tech sentiment catalyst; next Apple earnings estimated late October 2026
